# Hill Advertising Boulevard Plaza

> Hill Advertising occupies office space at Boulevard Plaza in Downtown Dubai, a twin-tower commercial complex on Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard next to the Burj Khalifa. The agency works in advertising and marketing communications. Completed in 2010, the two towers rise 37 and 30 storeys above ground and are capped by arched crowns drawn from traditional Islamic architecture, overlooking the Burj Khalifa boulevard and its restaurants.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This office fit-out for Hill Advertising is located at Boulevard Plaza, Emaar's twin-tower office development in Downtown Dubai with views towards Burj Khalifa. MENASCO carried out the fit-out works for the office, preparing the space for the agency's day-to-day operations within this established commercial address in the heart of the district.
